title: OZONOXY 200
pageDescription: Industrial ozone generator OZONOXY 200. Output 200 g/h. The most powerful system for large industrial facilities.
shortDesc: Industrial ozone generator with maximum output of 200 g/h. The most powerful OZONOXY system for large industrial sites.
description: OZONOXY 200 is the flagship model with 200 g/h output. It is designed to disinfect the largest industrial plants, production halls, warehouse complexes, and agricultural buildings. It delivers maximum ozone concentration for full disinfection, deodorization, and detoxification of large volumes. No consumables required — no ceramic plates, lamps, or similar parts.
features: No nitrogen oxide generation during ozone production
Highest output in the OZONOXY range
Fresh air supply via flexible duct for up to +20% higher output
Oxygen feed via quick-connect fitting for up to 50% higher output
Metal enclosure with two-stage coating (zinc primer + cured enamel)
Fine filtration — prevents electrode degradation from dust and grease buildup
Multimodal operation — distribute ozone flows across rooms or zones at different times, power levels, and exposure
No consumables (ceramic plates, lamps, or similar)
Ozone can be fed into ventilation ducts and piping
High ozone quality thanks to quartz discharge elements
Quick connection of pre-filters for use in heavily dusty environments
tasks: disinfection, pest control, rodent control, deodorization, detoxification, room demercurization, neutralization of toxic emissions
